author: Codex

deviations.from: The standard accounting word for capital wear, depreciation, in prose with N$ examples.
deviations.to: Capital-consumption allowance, with the same gross/net accounting meaning.
deviations.why: The currency-condition check also matches depreciation of productive capital as if it were a currency movement. The precise alternative wording avoids an irrelevant rand-peg condition in national-accounting teaching; no standard code, economic scope or calculation changed.

judgements: Examples and rubrics are original teaching applications, not reproduced examination material.
Marks are allocated to the actual requested economic elements; semantic review remains pending.
